Nothing was invented while the gap was open and no historical series required restatement when it closed.

THE SOURCE IS STILL INTERNALLY UNEVEN AND THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT TECHNICAL CAVEAT THIS RUN. The English and cache-busted German overviews both carry 07-September and agree line for line, and the per-metal nickel, zinc and lead tables have caught up. THE PER-METAL ALUMINIUM AND COPPER DAILY TABLES STILL END AT 04-SEPTEMBER. Those two rows are therefore taken from the two agreeing overviews and reconciled arithmetically against the 04-September table rows plus the published stock changes; the reconciliation balances five out of five to the tonne, but it is a reconciliation rather than a direct second reading and that is disclosed.

PREMIUM STALENESS REMAINS THE LARGEST LIMITATION FOR A PHYSICAL READER. MJP spot, European duty-unpaid, Rotterdam billets and the US Midwest transaction are all PERIODIC assessments carried at their last published marks with the assessment date shown on each row. They are not daily prices and they have not been interpolated, estimated or rolled forward.

THE PENDING Q4-2026 ASIAN PREMIUM RANGE IS HELD AT $290-325 AND HAS NOT BEEN NARROWED THIS RUN, because no newer dated public report on the talks was retrievable this morning. Both ends are quoted figures from the same dated 2026 source: the upper bound is the top of the published producer offer, the lower bound is the published buyer target.

ALUMINA AND RAW-MATERIAL ROWS ARE PERIODIC ASSESSMENTS CARRIED AT THEIR LAST DATED PUBLIC MARKS, with the assessment date shown on each row so staleness is visible rather than implied. Nothing between assessments has been interpolated.

INPUT-BASKET TREND SERIES CONTAIN PUBLISHED MARKS ONLY AND GAPS REMAIN GAPS. The copper row rolls daily because copper has a daily public price; the carbon, fluoride and alloying rows carry only their periodic settlements, so sparse two- and three-point series are correct rather than incomplete. Electricity, cathode blocks and titanium-boron grain refiner have NO public transacted series and their trend fields are deliberately empty.

NO EARNINGS-HISTORY COMPANY WAS BACK-FILLED THIS RUN. Two candidates were attempted against public sources - a third Rio Tinto aluminium half-year and a South32 FY26 standalone aluminium-segment EBITDA - and neither figure was separately published in a retrievable form. GAPS ARE LEFT AS GAPS RATHER THAN DERIVED, ESTIMATED OR INTERPOLATED.

THE INDEPENDENT PRICE REFERENCE AND THE EXCHANGE OFFICIAL ARE DIFFERENT MEASUREMENTS AND ARE NEVER MIXED. Trading Economics figures are CFD reference prices; they inform commentary and the macro panel, and they are not written into the official board, the spread, the KPI settlement figures or any history series.

THE $2.00 BACKWARDATION IS DIRECTIONALLY MEANINGFUL AND ECONOMICALLY TRIVIAL, and the page says so rather than dramatising it. It is two-hundredths of one percent on a $3,310 metal, the second such print in five sessions, and the August average spread was a $1.60 CONTANGO.
THE INVENTORY LEVEL AND THE INVENTORY FLOW ARE DIFFERENT ARGUMENTS AND ONLY THE LEVEL IS STILL BULLISH. Stock was unchanged on the session and has drawn 2,400 tonnes in fifteen sessions.

THE EXPLANATION OFFERED FOR THE MISSING BACKWARDATION - that Chinese semi-finished and alloy exports relieve Western tightness without passing through LME warehouses - IS A HYPOTHESIS CONSISTENT WITH THE PUBLISHED DATA, NOT A DEMONSTRATED FACT, and it is labelled as such wherever it appears.

THE EUR/USD PRIOR-MONTH AVERAGE ON THE BENCHMARK PANEL WAS NOT RECOMPUTABLE FROM THE PAGES RETRIEVED THIS RUN and is retained unchanged from its last published value rather than restated on judgement. The aluminium cash, three-month, spread and stock averages WERE recomputed from all twenty published August sessions.

ELLIOTT WAVE CONTENT IS TECHNICAL CONTEXT, NOT ADVICE, AND CARRIES EXPLICIT INVALIDATION LEVELS. The weekly count invalidates on a weekly close below 3,077; the daily count invalidates on a daily close below 3,183.
SCENARIO PROBABILITIES ARE HELD UNCHANGED THIS RUN BECAUSE THE NEW EVIDENCE CUT BOTH WAYS AND ROUGHLY CANCELLED. That is a deliberate decision, stated as such, rather than a failure to re-assess.

CONSENSUS FORECASTS ON THE OUTLOOK PANEL ARE DATED HOUSE VIEWS FROM THIRD PARTIES, CARRIED WITH THEIR PUBLICATION DATES. They are not this page's forecasts and several were published before the macro regime shifted from easing to tightening.

EVERYTHING ON THIS PAGE IS PUBLIC MARKET INFORMATION. No confidential, internal or company-specific commercial data appears anywhere on it, and no figure is published that cannot be traced to a cited public source.

THE 08-SEPTEMBER CANADIAN COUNTER-TARIFFS ARE CARRIED FROM THE ISSUING GOVERNMENT'S OWN PUBLISHED LIST AND CONTEMPORANEOUS TRADE REPORTING. The rate structure is 15%, 25% and 50% matched product-by-product to the corresponding US rate; the 50% figure quoted for steel and aluminium is the matched rate for those goods, not a blanket rate across the whole package.
